subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: What permanent Plugin SDK boundary should adopted-session upstream monitoring use for provider identity and activity classification?
rationale: The branch currently publishes bundled provider literals and Claude-specific classifiers, so changing this after release would create avoidable SDK compatibility debt; repository policy requires an explicit owner decision for this public plugin boundary.

options.title: Use a generic provider-owned seam
options.body: Store an opaque provider-defined source identity and marker in core while each catalog plugin owns its transcript parsing, provenance classification, and probing behavior.

options.title: Keep it bundled-only
options.body: Remove these additions from the public Plugin SDK and document that upstream monitoring is an internal contract limited to bundled Claude and Codex catalogs.

options.title: Defer to the observer design
options.body: Pause this PR and settle the broader durable SessionObserver API in the canonical issue before introducing a public monitoring contract.

recommendation.title: Use a generic provider-owned seam
recommendation.body: Store an opaque provider-defined source identity and marker in core while each catalog plugin owns its transcript parsing, provenance classification, and probing behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the session-state and explicit-watch layers, making them the strongest available feature-history owner for this boundary decision.
